mapper.select: SELECT sys01_company_id AS companyId , sys01_icam_company_cd AS icamCompanyCode FROM sys01_company WHERE CAST(sys01_company_id AS VARCHAR) LIKE #{companyId} AND sys01_icam_company_cd IS NOT NULL AND sys01_use_yn = 'true' AND sys01_erp_product_cd IN ('S3','A1') ORDER BY sys01_company_id
SELECT CAST(sys12_day AS date) FROM sys12_calendar WHERE sys12_company_id = 0 AND sys12_day BETWEEN #{startDate}::timestamp AND #{closeDate}::timestamp ORDER BY sys12_day
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fnd03_consignment SELECT f_create_seq() , icam03_consignment_cd , icam03_consignment_nm , 'true' , null , #{companyId} FROM ( SELECT icam03_consignment_cd , icam03_consignment_nm FROM icam03_fund WHERE icam03_icam_company_cd = #{icamCompanyCode} GROUP BY icam03_consignment_cd , icam03_consignment_nm ) t WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fnd03_consignment WHERE fnd03_company_id = #{companyId} AND fnd03_consignment_cd = icam03_consignment_cd )

INSERT INTO fnd09_trust_bank SELECT f_create_seq() , icam03_trust_bank_cd , icam03_trust_bank_nm , 'true' , null , #{companyId} FROM ( SELECT icam03_trust_bank_cd , COALESCE(icam03_trust_bank_nm, icam03_trust_bank_cd) icam03_trust_bank_nm FROM icam03_fund WHERE icam03_icam_company_cd = #{icamCompanyCode} AND icam03_trust_bank_cd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY icam03_trust_bank_cd , icam03_trust_bank_nm ) t WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fnd09_trust_bank WHERE fnd09_company_id = #{companyId} AND fnd09_trust_bank_cd = icam03_trust_bank_cd )

INSERT INTO fnd06_office_work SELECT f_create_seq() , icam03_office_work_cd , icam03_office_work_nm , 'true' , null , #{companyId} FROM ( SELECT icam03_office_work_cd , icam03_office_work_nm FROM icam03_fund WHERE icam03_icam_company_cd = #{icamCompanyCode} GROUP BY icam03_office_work_cd , icam03_office_work_nm ) t WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fnd06_office_work WHERE fnd06_company_id = #{companyId} AND fnd06_office_work_cd = icam03_office_work_cd )
